title: Morning Prayer
text:
MORNING PRAYER

Lord, I place this moment in Your hands.

Guide this day with calm courage and a faithful heart.

Let my words be gentle and my choices faithful. Amen.

title: Evening Prayer
text:
EVENING PRAYER

Heavenly Father, quiet my heart before You.

Let this night bring rest, mercy, and quiet trust.

Give me a grateful spirit and a steady mind. Amen.

title: Prayer for Family
text:
PRAYER FOR FAMILY

Jesus, lead me with mercy and truth.

Keep our home patient, gentle, and full of forgiving love.

Keep me from fear, haste, and bitterness. Amen.

title: Prayer for Peace
text:
PRAYER FOR PEACE

God of grace, draw near to my thoughts.

Teach my heart to choose peace before pride.

Let Your peace shape what I do next. Amen.

title: Prayer for Strength
text:
PRAYER FOR STRENGTH

Father, let Your light guide my steps.

Give me strength to do the next right thing.

Help me carry hope into the day. Amen.

title: Prayer for Wisdom
text:
PRAYER FOR WISDOM

Lord, teach me to trust You today.

Make my thoughts clear and my choices humble.

Make my heart humble, awake, and kind. Amen.

title: Prayer for Hope
text:
PRAYER FOR HOPE

Merciful God, meet me with peace.

Let hope rise again where worry has grown loud.

Hold what I cannot control in Your mercy. Amen.

title: Prayer of Gratitude
text:
PRAYER OF GRATITUDE

Jesus, keep my heart close to Your love.

Open my eyes to the blessings I keep missing.

Let love be stronger than worry in me. Amen.

title: Prayer for Protection
text:
PRAYER FOR PROTECTION

Lord, I place this moment in Your hands.

Keep my steps steady and my heart awake.

Let my words be gentle and my choices faithful. Amen.

title: Prayer for Work
text:
PRAYER FOR WORK

Heavenly Father, quiet my heart before You.

Bless honest work with patience, fairness, and purpose.

Give me a grateful spirit and a steady mind. Amen.

title: Prayer for Forgiveness
text:
PRAYER FOR FORGIVENESS

Jesus, lead me with mercy and truth.

Soften what is hard in me and restore what is broken.

Keep me from fear, haste, and bitterness. Amen.

title: Prayer for Children
text:
PRAYER FOR CHILDREN

God of grace, draw near to my thoughts.

Guard young hearts with kindness, wisdom, and safe paths.

Let Your peace shape what I do next. Amen.

title: Prayer for Courage
text:
PRAYER FOR COURAGE

Father, let Your light guide my steps.

Help me move with courage without losing gentleness.

Help me carry hope into the day. Amen.

title: Prayer for Comfort
text:
PRAYER FOR COMFORT

Lord, teach me to trust You today.

Stay near when words are small and grief is heavy.

Make my heart humble, awake, and kind. Amen.

title: Prayer for the Journey
text:
PRAYER FOR THE JOURNEY

Merciful God, meet me with peace.

Bless the road ahead, every departure, and every return.

Hold what I cannot control in Your mercy. Amen.

title: Prayer for Patience
text:
PRAYER FOR PATIENCE

Jesus, keep my heart close to Your love.

Teach me to wait without bitterness and act without fear.

Let love be stronger than worry in me. Amen.

title: Prayer for Healing
text:
PRAYER FOR HEALING

Lord, I place this moment in Your hands.

Bring comfort, wise care, and patient strength day by day.

Let my words be gentle and my choices faithful. Amen.

title: Prayer for Friendship
text:
PRAYER FOR FRIENDSHIP

Heavenly Father, quiet my heart before You.

Make my words loyal, honest, and kind.

Give me a grateful spirit and a steady mind. Amen.

title: Prayer for a Decision
text:
PRAYER FOR A DECISION

Jesus, lead me with mercy and truth.

Open the good door and close what would lead me away.

Keep me from fear, haste, and bitterness. Amen.

title: Prayer for Faith
text:
PRAYER FOR FAITH

God of grace, draw near to my thoughts.

Help my faith stay steady when the way is unclear.

Let Your peace shape what I do next. Amen.

Bring comfort, wise care, and patient strength day by day.

Keep me from fear, haste, and bitterness. Amen.

title: Prayer for Friendship
text:
PRAYER FOR FRIENDSHIP

Jesus, keep my heart close to Your love.

Make my words loyal, honest, and kind.

Let Your peace shape what I do next. Amen.

title: Prayer for a Decision
text:
PRAYER FOR A DECISION

Lord, I place this moment in Your hands.

Open the good door and close what would lead me away.

Help me carry hope into the day. Amen.

title: Prayer for Faith
text:
PRAYER FOR FAITH

Heavenly Father, quiet my heart before You.

Help my faith stay steady when the way is unclear.

Make my heart humble, awake, and kind. Amen.

title: Morning Prayer
text:
MORNING PRAYER

God of grace, draw near to my thoughts.

Guide this day with calm courage and a faithful heart.

Give me a grateful spirit and a steady mind. Amen.

title: Evening Prayer
text:
EVENING PRAYER

Father, let Your light guide my steps.

Let this night bring rest, mercy, and quiet trust.

Keep me from fear, haste, and bitterness. Amen.

title: Prayer for Family
text:
PRAYER FOR FAMILY

Lord, teach me to trust You today.

Keep our home patient, gentle, and full of forgiving love.

Let Your peace shape what I do next. Amen.

title: Prayer for Peace
text:
PRAYER FOR PEACE

Merciful God, meet me with peace.

Teach my heart to choose peace before pride.

Help me carry hope into the day. Amen.

title: Prayer for Strength
text:
PRAYER FOR STRENGTH

Jesus, keep my heart close to Your love.

Give me strength to do the next right thing.

Make my heart humble, awake, and kind. Amen.

title: Prayer for Wisdom
text:
PRAYER FOR WISDOM

Lord, I place this moment in Your hands.

Make my thoughts clear and my choices humble.

Hold what I cannot control in Your mercy. Amen.

title: Prayer for Hope
text:
PRAYER FOR HOPE

Heavenly Father, quiet my heart before You.

Let hope rise again where worry has grown loud.

Let love be stronger than worry in me. Amen.

title: Prayer of Gratitude
text:
PRAYER OF GRATITUDE

Jesus, lead me with mercy and truth.

Open my eyes to the blessings I keep missing.

Let my words be gentle and my choices faithful. Amen.

title: Prayer for Protection
text:
PRAYER FOR PROTECTION

God of grace, draw near to my thoughts.

Keep my steps steady and my heart awake.

Give me a grateful spirit and a steady mind. Amen.

title: Prayer for Work
text:
PRAYER FOR WORK

Father, let Your light guide my steps.

Bless honest work with patience, fairness, and purpose.

Keep me from fear, haste, and bitterness. Amen.

title: Prayer for Forgiveness
text:
PRAYER FOR FORGIVENESS

Lord, teach me to trust You today.

Soften what is hard in me and restore what is broken.

Let Your peace shape what I do next. Amen.

title: Prayer for Children
text:
PRAYER FOR CHILDREN

Merciful God, meet me with peace.

Guard young hearts with kindness, wisdom, and safe paths.

Help me carry hope into the day. Amen.

title: Prayer for Courage
text:
PRAYER FOR COURAGE

Jesus, keep my heart close to Your love.

Help me move with courage without losing gentleness.

Make my heart humble, awake, and kind. Amen.

title: Prayer for Comfort
text:
PRAYER FOR COMFORT

Lord, I place this moment in Your hands.

Stay near when words are small and grief is heavy.

Hold what I cannot control in Your mercy. Amen.

title: Prayer for the Journey
text:
PRAYER FOR THE JOURNEY

Heavenly Father, quiet my heart before You.

Bless the road ahead, every departure, and every return.

Let love be stronger than worry in me. Amen.

title: Prayer for Patience
text:
PRAYER FOR PATIENCE

Jesus, lead me with mercy and truth.

Teach me to wait without bitterness and act without fear.

Let my words be gentle and my choices faithful. Amen.

Bring comfort, wise care, and patient strength day by day.

Give me a grateful spirit and a steady mind. Amen.
